newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani leaders hail Deng as great statesman.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani leaders hail Deng as great statesman.

text.p: Pakistani leaders mourned Chinese supreme leader Deng Xiaoping on Thursday as a great statesman and friend of Pakistan whose death had ended an era.
"He was the guiding light who steered his nation to the path of reform, social justice and prosperity," said President Farooq Leghari in a message to his Chinese counterpart Jiang Zemin.
"His demise represents the passing away of an era. We in Pakistan share the grief of the great Chinese people. (He) will be remembered as a trusted friend of Pakistan," Leghari wrote.
Newly-elected Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif, who visited the Chinese embassy in Islamabad to present his condolences, said he had been deeply grieved at Deng's death.

In a message to Chinese Prime Minister Li Peng, he described Deng as a "wise and able statesman whose enlightened policies not only achieved laurels for the Chinese people, but were recognised the world over.
"His contribution to regional and world peace and stability has placed him among the great leaders of modern history," he said.
Pakistan has long made economic and defence cooperation with China a key element in its foreign policy, seeing Beijing as a potential ally against its regional arch-enemy India.
Deng died on Wednesday of respiratory failure.
